_comment: Visual-heavy subset for the visual evidence fallback (Prompt 2). Every question here asks for something that lives on the page as a mark, a dimension, a photograph, or a layout rather than in extracted text. Ids sqNN are the same ids as mlj017-adjusted-v2-batch-input.json so results are directly comparable against a text-only run; vfNN ids are new cases that target a specific visual task type.
